<!-- PHI-DIRECT -->
```powershell
Write-Output '=== COUNTESS GREY CENSUS 410 - THE MESH MATERIAL SLOTS AND THE RETARGET ASSET READ FROM THE REGISTRY (The pawn mesh stands named SM_Countess with physics asset PA_Countess_Phat_Extents, and an old load failure stands on record for the retarget path named in this job. No material census of the Countess has ever printed, so the grey render has no named address yet. This job runs one editor commandlet on the merged base and reads the asset registry whole for Countess: it prints the retarget asset as exists or absent from the registry, every Countess-named asset path up to forty, the SM_Countess path as the registry resolves it, its load road, the material slot count, and each slot with its material interface path or NONE. The commandlet log lines carrying the retarget path, LoadAsset, Failed, or Missing print after the census. The verdict names MATERIALS STAND with the real material count, or MATERIALS MISSING with the NONE count, and the retarget asset verdict stands on its own line. No edits anywhere.) ==='
$waited = 0
while ((Get-Process UnrealEditor -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue) -and $waited -lt 10) { Start-Sleep -Seconds 10; $waited++ }
if (Get-Process UnrealEditor -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue) { Write-Output 'PHI GREY410 NAMED HOLD: EDITOR STILL STANDING AFTER THE 100 SECOND IN-JOB WAIT - no commandlet launched into the contention'; Write-Output 'JOB 410 STOPPED'; return }
Write-Output 'PHI GREY410 EDITOR STATE AT PROCEED: no editor standing - proceeding on the clear road'
$base = 'D:\VEIL-OMNI'
$uproj = "$base\VEIL.uproject"
$cmdexe = 'C:\Program Files\Epic Games\UE_5.8\Engine\Binaries\Win64\UnrealEditor-Cmd.exe'
Write-Output '--- SECTION 1: REGISTRY CENSUS, LOAD, AND MATERIAL SLOTS ---'
$py = [System.Text.Encoding]::UTF8.GetString([System.Convert]::FromBase64String(''))
$out = "$base\Saved\phi_grey410.txt"
$py = $py.Replace('OUTFILE', "'$out'")
Set-Content "$base\Saved\phi_grey410.py" -Value $py -Encoding UTF8
Remove-Item $out -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue
& $cmdexe $uproj -run=pythonscript -script="$base\Saved\phi_grey410.py" -unattended -nopause -nosplash *> "$base\Saved\grey410.log"
if (Test-Path $out) { Get-Content $out | Write-Output } else { Write-Output 'NO GREY410 OUTPUT FILE'; Select-String -Path "$base\Saved\grey410.log" -Pattern 'Error|Traceback|Exception' | Select-Object -Last 8 | ForEach-Object { $_.Line.Trim() } | Write-Output }
Write-Output '--- SECTION 2: LOAD LOG LINES ---'
$logPattern = 'Paragon_Proto_Retarget|LoadAsset|Failed|Missing'
$hits = @(Select-String -Path "$base\Saved\grey410.log" -Pattern $logPattern -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue)
Write-Output ("PHI GREY410 LOG HIT COUNT=" + $hits.Count)
$hits | Select-Object -First 40 | ForEach-Object { $_.Line.Trim() } | Write-Output
Write-Output 'JOB 410 DONE'
```
